name: Vaultwarden
description: A password manager for the whole family that works with the Bitwarden apps and browser extensions.

settings.label: Admin page token
settings.hint: Opens /admin, where users are invited and settings changed.

settings.label: HTTPS
settings.hint: Serves the web vault over HTTPS with FreedomNAS's own certificate, the one of its web interface.

note: Browsers open the web vault only over HTTPS. With HTTPS on it uses FreedomNAS's own certificate: self-signed, so the browser warns once (compare its fingerprint with the WebUI's), and the Bitwarden phone apps accept it only once the certificate is installed on the phone; for those, a certificate of your own domain (reverse proxy) is the lasting way.
